== Summary ==
[[Emil Wallin]] at the bar with a large Krombacher glass during Day 3 of the [[2012 World Championship]] in Bochum, Germany, the event he won. The photographer's file name is "Euro Worlds Day 3 No 130"; Shadow 14 posted it with the caption "The right beer size" and, replying in the same thread, said of Wallin: "I know that this is a day 3 picture, but at Euro Worlds he drank a couple of those on DAY 1." The face matches [[:File:Emil Wallin 2015 Hall of Fame.jpg]].

* '''Event:''' [[2012 World Championship]]
* '''Date posted:''' 2016-01-22

== Source ==
Posted on the Players Committee forum: [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=1000599#p1000599 Jonny Chu's MPC TR], post 1000599, by Shadow 14, 2016-01-22.
